issues: The 2023 charter is the latest linked edition found; its current operational status needs confirmation. The homepage also links a 2021 edition.
Senior citizen processing steps sum to seven minutes, while page 13 prints a three-minute total. Processing time needs validation.
The 2025 FOI manual page 25 gives conflicting complex-request periods. Confirm the applicable deadline with the FOI Receiving Officer.
The FAQ says payments are office-only; a January 2025 post advertises LANDBANK payment. Merchant availability and fees are unverified.
The 2007 tariff page is historical. The April 2026 workbook is the newer published schedule.
Proposed-rate pages embed images from a different water district's development domain. No PRWD proposed rates were inferred.
The About page says sixteen (18) pumping stations. The pumping-station count needs validation.
Financial charts show 2020–2021, despite 2022 filenames. Exact values and scale are not recoverable from labels; no totals were estimated.
